status_note: Every UNHCR number on this page is checked against the Refugee Data Finder by tests/test_acceptance.py. The Government of India figure is still to confirm.

events.title: July 1983 riots: first large wave
events.note: Anti-Tamil violence across Sri Lanka in July 1983 is widely described as the start of large-scale flight of Tamils across the Palk Strait to Tamil Nadu.

events.title: 1990 to 1994: second wave
events.note: A second large wave of arrivals. UNHCR's series for this group in India starts in 1990, at its highest point.

events.title: Rajiv Gandhi assassinated
events.note: Former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi was assassinated at Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu, by an LTTE suicide bomber.

events.title: War ends
events.note: The Sri Lankan army defeated the LTTE in May 2009. UCDP records 2009 as the last year of this armed conflict.

events.title: Citizenship (Amendment) Act passed
events.note: India's Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019 gives a faster path to citizenship to some non-Muslim migrants from Afghanistan, Bangladesh and Pakistan. Sri Lankan Tamil refugees are not covered.

limitations.text: India has not signed the 1951 Refugee Convention
limitations.detail: UNHCR has a limited role in India, so its figures for this group rely on government data.
limitations.to_check: Confirm UNHCR's source note for Sri Lankan refugees in India.

limitations.text: Camp and non-camp refugees are not separated
limitations.detail: UNHCR gives one total; the Government of India counts camp residents and registered non-camp refugees separately.

limitations.text: The two sources count on different dates
limitations.detail: UNHCR counts on 31 December. The Government of India figure found so far is 'as on 1 January 2016', so UNHCR's end-2015 figure is the closest in time.

rows.label: Who is counted
rows.unhcr-pop-2026: Refugees from Sri Lanka recorded by UNHCR
rows.mea-2016: Camp residents plus refugees registered outside camps

rows.label: Method
rows.mea-2016: State records, given in an answer in Parliament

refugees.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, which relies on the Government of India for this group; not an independent count.
